name: minipty-vscode-sample
description: Minimal VS Code Pseudoterminal backed by the MiniPty NativeAOT helper.

minipty.helperPath.description: Absolute path to the published VsCodeTerminalHelper executable. MINIPTY_VSCODE_HELPER is used when this is empty.

minipty.helperArguments.description: Optional command and arguments passed to VsCodeTerminalHelper instead of its default shell.
